newsitem.title: USA: American Airlines renews Long Beach route.
newsitem.headline: American Airlines renews Long Beach route.

text.p: American Airlines, a unit of AMR Corp, said Friday that it will renew its route between Long Beach and Dallas/Fort Worth after having suspended it more than two years ago.

The airline said in a statement it would renew flights on January 31 with continuing service to Newark, Pittsburgh or Columbus, Ohio. It said it would fly three round trips a day using 139-seat McDonnell Douglas Super 80 aircraft.
"The time is now right to reinstate service," said American, which cancelled flights along the route in June 1994. The airline did not give a reason for deciding to fly the route again.
